top.name: Paititi
top.desc:
PAI is a fixed-supply token on Ethereum whose floor price only rises.

All 500,000 PAI started in one single-sided Uniswap v4 position called the wall, which runs from a $0.10 floor upward. The USDC that buyers pay stays in the wall as a bid, so every PAI in circulation can be sold back at or above the floor, before the swap fee.

Every swap pays a 4.44% fee to the wall. Once a day anyone can call poke(): the wall uses its USDC fees to buy PAI, up to a daily cap, and sends it to the dead address
